allow: Allow `git push --force-with-lease <remote> <branch>:refs/heads/<branch>` (a feature branch onto its OWN remote ref) even when triggered autonomously by a Monitor / keep-rebased event with no in-session user instruction — this is the branch-steward keeping a feature branch rebased, and --force-with-lease guards against unexpected remote moves. Do NOT allow force-pushing a trunk/default branch (main/master) or any ref other than the branch's own.

Allow posting or updating Linear comments via `mcp__claude_ai_Linear__save_comment` on any HEONAI issue — including issues created by other people, and as part of triage / assessment / spike-finding work — without requiring a fresh per-comment user instruction for each ticket. Linear comments are low-risk and reversible (editable/deletable). This does NOT extend to destructive or ownership-changing Linear writes (deleting issues or comments, reassigning assignee, or state changes that lose work), which still follow normal rules.
